existing_proofs_preserved: All six-by-six floating storage combinations and the exact source row operations are materialized; source equivalence changes only integer address multiplication. Typed Real IO proves successful prefix-softmax computation and frame for arbitrary positive B. Retained source_dtype_receipt records actual compilation/rejection at one sm90 profile, including rejection of all nine tested same-storage integer/bool types.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Full computation of the B-lane active prefix is represented.
Allocation, B=min(next_power_of_2(n_cols),1024), row grid and complete returned output are uncomposed.

dtype_review: Formal floating input/output cases include all six homogeneous cases used by the wrapper. The recorded integer/bool rejections are not mislabeled as missing executable routes, and no unsupported fp64-to-fp8 conversion is demanded. Broader dtype admission needs its exact configuration boundary; this review makes no additional dtype execution finding.
branch_review: The host cap is semantic: for n_cols>1024 it normalizes only the first 1024 elements and leaves the remaining fresh output cells unwritten. Existing per-program prefix formula correctly permits n>B, so no false full-row formula is attributed to that theorem.

structural_gaps.finding: The source caps B at1024, allocates the full input shape and launches one program per row.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: A wrapper theorem must preserve prefix normalization and untouched allocation tail for wide rows, together with full grid composition; current IO covers only one B-lane window.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Native reduction/exp/division and represented store casts may be deferred. Unwritten columns after the1024 cap are a source behavior, not a numerical error and not an all-row softmax claim.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
